types.name: Pointing and introducing
types.description: A person points to someone, introduces someone or looks at a photograph and describes the link in one sentence ("He is the son of my grandfather's only son"); asks how the two are related.

types.name: Direct statements
types.description: A few plain sentences give family links (A is the brother of B, B is the daughter of C) and ask how two people are related.

types.name: Coded relations
types.description: Symbols or letters stand for relations (A + B means A is the father of B, A @ B means …); decode an expression such as P + Q × R − S, or pick the expression that shows a given relation.

types.name: Family puzzle
types.description: A larger family with several members, couples or generations is described; asks to count members (males, couples), find someone's gender, or identify a person from the full family tree.
